lines.text: Near Bethphage and Bethany, Jesus sends two disciples to untie a colt and say, "The Lord needs it."
The disciples find the colt as Jesus said, answer its owners, and throw their cloaks over it before Jesus rides.
As Jesus nears the Mount of Olives descent, the disciples praise God for the miracles and call Him the Prophet.
Some Pharisees ask Jesus to rebuke His disciples, and He says the trees will cry out if they are silent.
Jesus weeps over Jerusalem and says enemies will level it because it did not recognize the time of God's visit.
